2026-09-18.headline: Sprint 40 is mid-way with little closed yet, but nothing is blocked.
summary: 2 of 34 points are done (6%) at the sprint midpoint. Five stories are in progress and should land next week.
The Android 12 rotation crash (ATL-109) was hotfixed in 1.14.2.
No blockers. The main schedule risk is ATL-101: the Apple sign-in half needs an Apple entitlement that can take days to approve.

actions.Burndown: Check in at Monday stand-up on what will close by Friday; flag anything that will not.
actions.ATL-101: Submit the Sign in with Apple entitlement request now so Apple review does not gate the sprint.

asks: Lena: confirm the Apple entitlement request for ATL-101 is submitted by Mon Sep 21.

2026-09-25.headline: Sprint 40 closed at 53% (18 of 34 pts). Three items carry into Sprint 41.
summary: Delivered: onboarding design v2, both welcome carousels, account creation API v2 and the Android crash fix.
Carrying over 16 pts: ATL-101 social sign-in (Apple half), ATL-106 email verification (in review) and ATL-107 analytics (not started).
Sprint 41 is planned at 50 pts against an 18-pt first-sprint velocity. That plan is very likely to slip.

actions.Burndown: Review why 3 items slipped in the retro; size Sprint 41 against 18-20 pts.
actions.Scope creep: Hold mid-sprint adds to bugs only.

asks: Product (Maya): trim Sprint 41 from 50 pts to about 30 at planning on Mon Sep 28.
Procurement: start the VeriID contract now; ATL-108 KYC needs sandbox keys in Sprint 41.

2026-10-02.headline: Sprint 41 has two blockers, including the release-critical KYC integration.
summary: 5 of 50 points done (10%) at the sprint midpoint. The 50-pt commitment is 2.8x the 18-pt average velocity.
New blocker ATL-108 (KYC, Highest): no VeriID sandbox keys until Procurement signs the vendor contract.
New blocker ATL-101: Apple has not yet approved the Sign in with Apple entitlement for the production bundle.
ATL-106 email verification is done; ATL-107 analytics has started after carrying over.

actions.ATL-108: Procurement to give a contract signature date by Tue Oct 6; Lena to build against mocked VeriID responses meanwhile.
actions.ATL-101: Follow up with Apple developer support; ship Google sign-in independently if Apple slips past Oct 9.
actions.Over-commitment: Agree now which ~25 pts will not make it, so the slip is planned rather than discovered.
actions.Burndown: Daily burndown check until the blockers clear.

asks: Procurement: VeriID contract signature date by Tue Oct 6 (ATL-108).
Product: confirm which Sprint 41 stories can drop if the KYC blocker holds.

2026-10-09.headline: Sprint 41 closed at 54% (27 pts), the best sprint so far, but KYC is still blocked.
summary: Delivered 27 pts: social sign-in (Apple entitlement approved Oct 6), email verification, analytics, iOS profile screen, rate limiting and the accessibility audit.
ATL-108 KYC has been blocked 9 days. The VeriID contract moved from Procurement to Legal for DPA review.
Carrying 23 pts into Sprint 42: ATL-108, ATL-111 Android profile, ATL-112 push opt-in (PR #219 in review) and ATL-115 E2E tests (not started).
Ben (QA) is at 50% on Payments regression from Oct 5, which puts the E2E suite at risk.

actions.ATL-108: Ask Legal for a DPA review date; if none by Oct 14, escalate to the Eng Director.
actions.ATL-112: Request a Mobile Platform reviewer for PR #219 before planning.
actions.Over-commitment: Plan Sprint 42 at 25 pts or less including carry-over.

asks: Legal: date for the VeriID DPA review (ATL-108).
QA manager: restore Ben to 100% on Atlas for the release, or name a backup for ATL-115.

2026-10-16.headline: Sprint 42 is off track: 11% done at the midpoint with three blockers and a production incident.
summary: 5 of 46 points done (11%) against 50% of the sprint elapsed. 42 pts were committed against a 22.5-pt average.
Blockers went from 1 to 3: ATL-108 KYC (16 days, Legal DPA), ATL-119 consent screen (Legal copy approval) and ATL-118 localisation (translation vendor).
PR #219 for ATL-112 has had no review in 8 days. ATL-115 E2E tests still have not started after 18 days.
Production incident INC-342 (verification links expiring after 5 minutes) pulled Omar onto hotfix ATL-120, slowing magic-link login (ATL-116).

actions.ATL-108: Eng Director to escalate the DPA review with Legal this week; ask for one review covering both VeriID and the consent copy.
actions.ATL-119: Bundle with the ATL-108 Legal ask; build the screen with placeholder copy behind the feature flag.
actions.ATL-118: Get a delivery date from LinguaPro; fall back to English-only for the first rollout cohort.
actions.ATL-112: Platform lead to assign a reviewer for PR #219 within 24 hours.
actions.ATL-115: Pair Jordan with Ben for 2 days to scaffold the Detox/Espresso suite.
actions.Scope creep: Take the incident fix as unplanned work, but move ATL-122 to Sprint 43 unless something comes out.
actions.Burndown: Daily burndown review; decide at Tue stand-up what moves to Sprint 43.

asks: Eng Director: escalate the Legal review (VeriID DPA + consent copy) this week.
Platform lead: reviewer for PR #219 (ATL-112) within 24 hours.
QA manager: Ben back to 100% for Atlas through the Nov 6 release.

2026-10-23.headline: Sprint 42 closed at 20% (10 of 51 pts). The Nov 6 release is at risk and needs a scope decision this week.
summary: Lowest delivery of the three sprints: 10 pts, against 18 and 27 before. 41 open pts roll into Sprint 43, which is nearly twice the 22.5-pt average velocity, with GA in 14 days.
Both release gates are waiting on the same Legal review: ATL-108 KYC has been blocked 23 days and ATL-119 consent screen 10 days. Legal has given no date.
PR #219 (ATL-112 push opt-in) has been in review 15 days; its second approver is out until Oct 28. ATL-115 E2E tests are untouched after 25 days.
9 pts were added mid-sprint, mostly bugs. ATL-121 (Apple 'Hide My Email' sign-in failure, ~4% of iOS signups on staging) is Highest and in progress.
Good news: localisation strings landed (ATL-118 unblocked and done) and the INC-342 verification-link hotfix shipped.

actions.ATL-108: Get a Legal decision by Wed Oct 28. If none, take KYC out of the Nov 6 scope and ship it behind the flag in a follow-up release.
actions.ATL-119: Same Legal review as ATL-108. Ask Legal to approve the consent copy first, separately, since it is a smaller decision.
actions.ATL-112: Platform lead to name a different second approver on Mon Oct 26 instead of waiting for Oct 28.
actions.ATL-115: Make E2E the top Sprint 43 item for Ben at 100%; without it there is no release sign-off.
actions.ATL-122: Pull into Sprint 43 week 1; the staged rollout depends on it.
actions.Over-commitment: Commit Sprint 43 at 23 pts or less. Order: ATL-121, ATL-122, ATL-115, ATL-112, ATL-117, then ATL-116.
actions.Scope creep: Keep a 4-pt buffer in Sprint 43 for beta bugs instead of adding them on top.
actions.Burndown: Run Sprint 43 with a mid-sprint go/no-go on Mon Nov 2.
actions.Load: Move ATL-117 review follow-ups off Lena so she can focus on ATL-121 and KYC.

asks: Legal: decision on the VeriID DPA and the GDPR consent copy by Wed Oct 28 (ATL-108, ATL-119).
Product (Maya): choose by Thu Oct 29 between shipping Nov 6 without KYC (flagged off) or moving GA to Nov 20.
Platform lead: second approver for PR #219 on Mon Oct 26 (ATL-112).
QA manager: Ben at 100% on Atlas through GA for the E2E suite (ATL-115).
